report:
Reviewed the complete body_local_quiescence claim, all six ordinary implementation associations, and both associated tests. Requirements are (1) a body query owns its inference context, variables, versions, tasks, and obligations; (2) publication resolves every type reachable in the completed tree; and (3) publication cannot retain live tasks, obligations, or speculative branches. LocalFnSym::body constructs a new InferCtx for that query, checks its body, calls finalize, then consumes the context through finish. InferCtx owns its egraph, runtime, obligation manager, working stash, and wake queue directly; its constructor initializes fresh state. These mutable objects are not included in CheckedBody. The body task completes before finalize/finish. The scoped runtime drops outstanding scoped futures on scope exit, and owned Runtime tasks remain visible to its guard until completed.

InferCtx::finish asserts has_pending is false, ROOT is a leaf, runtime is quiescent, and pending_wakes is empty before constructing CheckedBody. ObligationManager::has_pending treats both Ready and Stalled as pending and accepts only Terminal, so a stalled obligation cannot evade the boundary. Runtime::is_quiescent checks both the task map and ready queue, so an idle pending task is still live. VersionTree::is_leaf checks the live root has no children; branch creation links every child and removal recursively removes descendants, so any remaining speculative subtree prevents publication. finalize drives obligations, resolves remaining variables to diagnosed error recovery where needed, retries and terminally discharges obligations, then drains wakes/tasks. Its completion cannot bypass the finish assertions.

finalize_typed_body constructs a fresh stash and copies the rooted tree. BodyFinalizer::copy_ty resolves egraph representatives and panics on any remaining InferVar; nested ADT/alias arguments, references, tuples, slices, arrays, and function signatures recurse. copy_expr and its data traversal cover child expressions, resolved-call dispatch and type arguments, casts, patterns, statement annotations, match arms and closure parameters. Unresolved expression slots are replaced by their filled expression; recursive types/slots are rejected. This establishes the publication guard also for nested types, rather than merely testing the root's outer constructor. Ty::Param and diagnosed Ty::Error are legitimate resolved representations, not live inference. The captured egraph find dependency follows parent representatives to a root.

The ordinary body_finalization_resolves_types_into_a_fresh_stash test constructs a variable unified to i32 inside a tuple, finalizes it, asserts the original stash still contains InferVar, and inspects the completed tuple element as i32. It is substantive focused evidence for recursive resolution and copying, but does not exercise the whole query or finish's negative guards. The separate explicit TODO inference_body_local_quiescence accurately reserves the broader verification matrix: representative completed body inspection and finish rejection with live variables, obligations, tasks and branches, with diagnostic recovery distinguished. Accept this existing deferral as test TODO, not executed coverage or a claim that the full matrix exists. Its prerequisite is constructing those controlled live states at the finish boundary and a representative typed tree with explicit recovery expectations. No implementation omission was identified from source inspection; the remaining verification scope remains visibly deferred.

Added essential association comments for finalizer, body query and guard helper files so later changes participate in anchor freshness, then restarted review on current inputs. Ran cargo fmt, cargo test -p sage-ir body_finalization_resolves_types_into_a_fresh_stash (one passed), and cargo build (passed with existing warnings). Other described cases are source inspection, not reported as executed tests. Centralized post-codegen and Sage sanity delegation is handled by the coordinator for these comment-only edits.
